method: Isolated headless Chrome through Chrome DevTools MCP on the server Mac; no CPU/network throttling. One cold retrieval before/after, three warm refreshes per build. Double requestAnimationFrame after row DOM exists is a render-ready proxy, not presentation timing or INP. Origin and OS caches were not flushed. No competitor comparison.
